mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity_item WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN 'crm.label.opportunityProduct' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_ticket WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN 'crm.label.serviceTicket' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN 'crm.label.opportunity2' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_ticket WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN 'crm.label.serviceTicket' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_followup WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN 'crm.label.followUp' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_contact WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN 'crm.label.contact' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_customer WHERE owner_id = #{id}) THEN 'crm.label.customerOwner' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity WHERE owner_id = #{id}) THEN 'crm.label.opportunity2' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_lead WHERE owner_id = #{id}) THEN 'crm.label.lead' END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_customer WHERE dept_id = #{id}) THEN 'crm.label.customer' END
